exposure: 2 ml of 0.75% hyperbaric Ropivacaine in dextrose 80 mg/ml
cohort: 80 patients aged 21-30 years, ASA physical status 1 and 2, scheduled for elective caesarean section under spinal anesthesia.
finding: Hyperbaric ropivacaine provided a faster onset, earlier mobilization, and better motor block quality compared to isobaric ropivacaine for elective caesarean section.
